title: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram + report scaffold + export (screening log, extraction dataset, licence/attribution manifest) + reproducibility manifest
context: A PRISMA 2020-compliant systematic review requires a flow diagram whose record counts reconcile across identification, screening, eligibility, and included stages; a report scaffold covering PRISMA 2020 checklist items; exports of the screening log and extraction dataset for hand-off to statistical tools; a per-output licence + attribution manifest; and a reproducibility manifest that lets the AI-assisted steps be re-derived. WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility is required for the local review UI surfaces. Depends on 008 (screening audit log), 012 (eval harness, whose counts feed the flow), and 013 (extraction dataset).
objective: Implement PRISMA reporting, export, and reproducibility (core/prisma) in @hee-lee-oss/sra-core: generate a PRISMA 2020 flow diagram whose counts reconcile to the identification/screening/eligibility/included logs; produce a report scaffold covering PRISMA 2020 checklist items; export the screening log and extraction dataset as CSV and JSON with a per-output licence + attribution manifest; and produce a reproducibility manifest (model id+version+prompt hash per AI-assisted step, human actors) so the AI-assisted steps of a completed review can be re-derived.
acceptanceCriteria: The PRISMA 2020 flow diagram generator reads counts from the audit log (identification, dedup, screening, eligibility, included) and emits a diagram whose counts reconcile (sum checks pass); reconciliation failures are surfaced as errors, not silently swallowed
A PRISMA 2020 report scaffold is generated covering the required checklist items; each item links to the relevant section of the audit log or extraction dataset for evidence

The screening log and extraction dataset are exportable as CSV and JSON; each export is accompanied by a per-output licence + attribution manifest listing: each source's licence, which content may be redistributed, and attribution requirements

A reproducibility manifest is generated for any completed review: records the model id + version + prompt hash for every AI-assisted screening suggestion and extraction proposal, the human actors and their disposition timestamps, and the gold-standard eval report version; this is sufficient to re-derive the AI-assisted steps

The local review UI (CLI output or web UI) passes WCAG 2.2 AA on colour contrast and keyboard navigation for its primary screening/extraction surfaces; expanded eval and policy-layer suites remain green
Tests cover: flow-diagram count reconciliation, licence manifest completeness, reproducibility manifest round-trip, and WCAG 2.2 AA lint on UI output; all run in CI; pnpm build && pnpm test pass
output: A merged PR adding PRISMA 2020 flow diagram generation, report scaffold, CSV/JSON export with licence/attribution manifests, and reproducibility manifests to @hee-lee-oss/sra-core (core/prisma), with WCAG 2.2 AA on local UI surfaces and a full test suite.
